title: MASTER DISCOVERY CHALLENGE (integrated multi-engine dataset)
synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC DATA - produced by a mathematical model with a fixed random seed. It is NOT a real astronomical, medical, seismic or experimental observation.
noise_model: white Gaussian + AR(1) coloured per channel

signal_components.note: periodic 2 (overlaps periodic 1; separation 0.04 Hz, resolution 3.3e-4 Hz)

index_convention: indices are 0-based data-row numbers (header excluded); CSV line number = index + 2
sinusoid_convention: x(t) = sum A_i sin(2*pi*f_i*t + phi_i); phase in radians
snr_definition: SNR_dB = 10*log10( mean(clean_signal^2) / mean(noise^2) ) using the realised arrays
